title: Jonathan Attacks the Philistine Outpost
description: Jonathan and his armor-bearer secretly cross over to the Philistine outpost at Micmash. They present a sign to the Lord, climb up the cliff, and kill about twenty men. A panic from God comes over the Philistine camp, the ground shakes, and the enemy turns their swords against each other. Saul and the people join the battle, and the Lord saves Israel that day.
